unlocks._about: How skills open. Numbers are how many skills must be finished; "all" means every skill in that group.

zones.name: Induction
zones.pitch: Three core skills for reading and writing at work and in life. Finish any two to open the site.

zones.name: Digital Life
zones.pitch: Websites, podcasts, socials and staying safe online. Make content that works.

zones.name: Issues & Voices
zones.pitch: Who’s saying what, and why? Read opinions closely and argue your own.

zones.name: Real-World Docs
zones.pitch: Tax, insurance, manuals and fine print. The paperwork of adult life, decoded.

zones.name: On the Job
zones.pitch: Rights, rosters, procedures and safety talks. Read and write like a pro at work.

zones.name: Advocate
zones.pitch: Brand yourself, back a cause, pitch an idea and speak up for what matters.

zones.name: Capstones
zones.pitch: Big real-world projects that mix two areas. Unlock by going deep in both.

skills.title: Your First Payslip
skills.tagline: The most important thing your job will ever send you.
skills.realLife: Read a payslip, check you’ve been paid right, and know what to do if you haven’t.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of a workplace text; purpose, audience and context; annotation; inferring meaning.

skills.title: In Your Own Words
skills.tagline: Copy-paste gets you caught. Learn to say it your way.
skills.realLife: Take notes, paraphrase and summarise so you can use information honestly — at school, at TAFE and at work.
skills.literacy: Paraphrasing, note taking and summarising; plagiarism and its consequences.

skills.title: Write It Right
skills.tagline: Draft it, fix it, send it. No cringe.
skills.realLife: Plan, draft, edit and proofread messages and emails so you come across clearly and professionally.
skills.literacy: The writing process (plan, draft, revise, edit, proofread); conventions of literacy.

skills.title: Lock It Down
skills.tagline: Passwords, scams and privacy — protect your digital life.
skills.realLife: Keep your accounts, money and identity safe online.
skills.literacy: Features and importance of digital security; safe practices online.

skills.title: Website Detective
skills.tagline: Is this site legit? How would you know?
skills.realLife: Work out how a website is built, who it’s for, and whether you can trust it.
skills.literacy: Structure, purpose and audience of webpages; comparing and evaluating digital texts.

skills.title: Credit Where It’s Due
skills.tagline: Using someone’s music, pic or words? Know the rules.
skills.realLife: Use images, music and information legally and give credit properly.
skills.literacy: Copyright and attribution; referencing; using sources to create new content.

skills.title: Respect Online
skills.tagline: Group chats, comments and calling it out — the right way.
skills.realLife: Handle group chats, comment sections and online disagreements respectfully.
skills.literacy: Respectful digital interactions; etiquette and conventions of discussion.

skills.title: Make a Podcast
skills.tagline: Plan, script and record an episode people would actually listen to.
skills.realLife: Create a short podcast or video for a community, workplace or vocational audience.
skills.literacy: Differences between digital texts; planning, creating and editing digital content for an audience.

skills.title: Who’s Talking?
skills.tagline: Every opinion comes from somewhere.
skills.realLife: Work out who is behind an opinion and what they want you to think.
skills.literacy: How values, backgrounds, bias and perspective shape what authors and speakers say.

skills.title: Loaded Words
skills.tagline: Same fact, different words, totally different feeling.
skills.realLife: Spot how word choices and images push you to feel a certain way.
skills.literacy: Language and visuals used to influence; connotations of words.

skills.title: Check the Source
skills.tagline: Before you share it, back it, or believe it.
skills.realLife: Find trustworthy information and compare how different sources cover an issue.
skills.literacy: Note-taking and annotation of arguments; comparing persuasive texts; reliable sources.

skills.title: Back It Up
skills.tagline: An opinion without evidence is just noise.
skills.realLife: Write a clear, logical opinion piece with evidence that convinces people.
skills.literacy: Structures of persuasive texts; logic, reasoning and emotion; evidence; sequencing an argument.

skills.title: Have Your Say
skills.tagline: Stand up and make your point — with proof.
skills.realLife: Present your point of view out loud, backed by evidence, and handle questions.
skills.literacy: Oral communication; presenting a point of view with evidence; discussion and debate.

skills.title: Tax Time
skills.tagline: TFNs, tax returns and myGov — without the stress.
skills.realLife: Understand tax forms and advice so you can sort your tax with confidence.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of tax forms and advice; reading and inferring from official texts.

skills.title: Find It in the Manual
skills.tagline: Contents, headings, index — find the answer fast.
skills.realLife: Find what you need in manuals, handbooks and long documents without reading every page.
skills.literacy: Key elements of complex technical documents: contents, headings, sub-headings, indexes.

skills.title: Insurance Decoded
skills.tagline: What are you actually covered for?
skills.realLife: Read insurance forms and documents for cars, phones and renting.
skills.literacy: Features of insurance forms; key elements of complex texts; inferring meaning.

skills.title: Speak Their Language
skills.tagline: Every workplace has its own words. Learn to crack them.
skills.realLife: Understand the jargon, acronyms and style of different organisations and industries.
skills.literacy: How organisations, groups and businesses develop their own use of language.

skills.title: Compare the Deals
skills.tagline: Bank accounts, phone plans, rentals — which one wins?
skills.realLife: Compare documents that do the same job and decide which gives you the best information and deal.
skills.literacy: Comparing and contrasting texts with similar purposes; evaluating how well they inform.

skills.title: Rights at Work
skills.tagline: Know what you’re owed — and what you owe.
skills.realLife: Read information about your rights and responsibilities at work and find reliable help.
skills.literacy: Structure, language, purpose and audience of informational texts about rights and responsibilities.

skills.title: Workplace Messages
skills.tagline: Rosters, shift swaps and emails to the boss.
skills.realLife: Read and write the everyday messages that keep a workplace running.
skills.literacy: Structure and characteristics of organisational texts; conventions of literacy.

skills.title: Write the Procedure
skills.tagline: If it’s not written down, it didn’t happen.
skills.realLife: Write clear step-by-step instructions with visuals that someone new could follow.
skills.literacy: Creating procedural and instructional content for a workplace audience.

skills.title: Toolbox Talk
skills.tagline: Run a five-minute safety briefing like a site boss.
skills.realLife: Give and listen to a workplace safety briefing.
skills.literacy: Oral communication; conventions of discussion; explaining the purpose of informational texts.

skills.title: Make an Induction Pack
skills.tagline: Welcome the next new starter — properly.
skills.realLife: Create an induction brochure, set of instructions or vlog for a real or realistic workplace.
skills.literacy: Creating organisational, informational and procedural texts for a workplace audience.

skills.title: Brand You
skills.tagline: What do people find when they look you up?
skills.realLife: Build a personal brand for jobs, apprenticeships or your own side hustle.
skills.literacy: Language choices for audience and purpose; layout, design and structure of promotional texts.

skills.title: Why Ads Work
skills.tagline: They’re not selling a product. They’re selling a feeling.
skills.realLife: Work out how promotional material gets you to buy, join or care.
skills.literacy: Visual cues and presentation; evaluating promotional and influential material.

skills.title: Promote a Cause
skills.tagline: Back a local group and get people on board.
skills.realLife: Create a brochure, webpage or social post that advocates for a community group you care about.
skills.literacy: Structures and features of advocacy texts; designing influential material; drafting and editing.

skills.title: Pitch It
skills.tagline: Sixty seconds to sell your idea.
skills.realLife: Pitch a product or idea out loud to an audience that matters.
skills.literacy: Oral communication; communication techniques for different settings; promotional content.

skills.title: Speak Up: Your Presentation
skills.tagline: Your topic. Your voice. Your showcase.
skills.realLife: Plan and deliver an informative or instructional presentation on civic participation or managing everyday life.
skills.literacy: Structuring oral content to advise or advocate; evidence; delivery; evaluating your own work.

skills.title: Job-Ready Kit
skills.tagline: Resume, cover email and pitch — ready to send.
skills.realLife: Put together a complete application for a real job or apprenticeship.
skills.literacy: Creating workplace texts and promotional material about yourself for a specific audience.

skills.title: Community Campaign
skills.tagline: Pick an issue. Build a campaign. Make it count.
skills.realLife: Run a mini campaign on a local issue: an argument, a post and a short speech.
skills.literacy: Arguing a point of view with evidence; designing advocacy material.

skills.title: Adulting Admin
skills.tagline: myGov, banking and bills — all sorted.
skills.realLife: Set up and manage the accounts and paperwork of independent life.
skills.literacy: Accessing and using real-life documents; digital security.

skills.title: Workplace Explainer Video
skills.tagline: Teach a work skill in under three minutes.
skills.realLife: Script and make a short explainer video about a task in a workplace you know.
skills.literacy: Creating digital and instructional content for a workplace audience.
